services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: As a B-Corporation, it is part of our mission to support art in education, in a variety of forms. One way we do that is by welcoming school groups for field trips, with free or reduced admission. Interested in bringing your group to experience immersive, interactive, collaborative art? Fill out the request form below and our team will get back to you soon. Requests must be made at least 3 weeks prior to your visit in order to make the necessary arrangements. Want to incorporate Mix-Tape into your Arts Education curriculum? Check out our Arts Ed Workbook, which introduces the basic principles of art and design through exploring Mix-Tape. DOWNLOAD PDF. Field trips must be scheduled on weekday

services.name: Open Mic Night
services.desc: We’re partnering with Make Oklahoma Weirder to invite performers of all disciplines and backgrounds to perform on Factory Obscura's Wonder Stage located inside the Mix-Tape immersive art experience. Each month will have a theme artists can base their performance on. It is encouraged to interpret the theme in any way the performer sees fit. It is not required to adhere to the theme. Only the Angst and Wonder rooms will be accessible during Open Mic Nights to keep the energy focused on the performances. Tickets are $10Performers get in FREE with an advance sign upLIMITED SLOTS

services.desc: A Group Rate of $5 off for Adults and $3 off for kids 17 & under is available for parties of 10 or more during normal business hours. services.name: Full Moon Yoga in wonder
services.desc: Participants can explore the full Mix-Tape experience before the session begins. Join us for an intentional gathering and gentle movement led by Beth White of This Land Yoga as we dig into the offerings of the full moon. This time may provide abundance for those willing to slow down long enough to listen. Sinking into the atmosphere of the Wonder Room will allow for imagination to spark, and open the heart to receive and expand. This session will include slow restorative stretching and sound healing.
